mapper.select: select id, class_id, module_code, module_name, count_type, min_count, max_count, need_formula, need_image, need_code, editable, create_time, update_time from te_module_set where class_id = #{classId} order by module_code
mapper.insert: insert into te_module_set (class_id, module_code, module_name, count_type, min_count, max_count, need_formula, need_image, need_code, editable, create_time, update_time) values (#{classId}, #{moduleCode}, #{moduleName}, #{countType}, #{minCount}, #{maxCount}, #{needFormula}, #{needImage}, #{needCode}, #{editable}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) on duplicate key update module_name = #{moduleName}, count_type = #{countType}, min_count = #{minCount}, max_count = #{maxCount}, need_formula = #{needFormula}, need_image = #{needImage}, need_code = #{needCode}, editable = #{editable}, update_time = #{updateTime}
